svg.aria-label: 2. MedClaw, with Admin Clerk. An agent that operates desktop software on its own. A computer-use agent that drives a custom Python RPA system over the Model Context Protocol. Built with Python, MCP, RPA, SQLAlchemy, Gemini 2.5 Flash (evaluation).
